docs.desc: FERMI Q3 2026 EARNINGS RELEASE, DATED NOVEMBER 12, 2026

reports.title: Fermi Announces New Agreements with Investment-Grade Hyperscaler and Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

desk.headline: Pre-revenue; loss of $0.22 a share, wider than estimates; hyperscaler commits ~$200m prepayment for 600 MW; no guidance
results: Fermi, which is building a private power and data-centre campus in Texas, still has no revenue.
Net loss was $141.6m ($0.22 a share), wider than the roughly $0.07 expected; costs included $65.8m of stock pay and $21.5m of adviser fees paid in shares.
An unnamed investment-grade hyperscaler agreed a $200m prepayment and a $15m early-works deal for 600 MW from 2027; a $90m steel sale is being finalised but no lease is signed yet.
The August lease with TensorWave, and the related AMD credit support, have been terminated.
Spent $133.4m on the site in the quarter; cash fell to $315.5m while net debt rose to $958.4m after a July convertible note issue.

guidance.summary: Fermi gives no financial guidance; it is pre-revenue and spending is tied to the buildout.

points: The prepayment wire was due by 13 November; the long-term lease is described as far along, with site work targeted from 1 December.
First power for the hyperscaler's first building is targeted for late Q2 or early Q3 2027.
Management prefers direct hyperscaler deals to complex turnkey leases like the cancelled TensorWave one; it wants four to five such anchor tenants.
Funding is shifting from company cash to customer prepayments and project-level debt and equity; amending the turbine loan cost about $25m in fees.
Risks cited include paused Texas air permits, grid connection freezes and a tighter high-yield bond market.
call.source: Fermi Q3 2026 earnings call transcript — The Motley Fool via Mitrade, 12 Nov 2026

watch: Signing of the definitive lease and steel agreement, and receipt of the $200m prepayment.
Whether a second tenant signs for the remaining 2.2 GW of capacity.
Funding for the buildout and further growth in debt.
